control: User access to production is approved by the system owner before it is granted
User access to production is reviewed and inappropriate access removed
Access is removed within 1 working day of an employee leaving
MFA is enforced for all workforce accounts
Production changes are peer reviewed and approved before deployment
Production databases are encrypted at rest
Backups are taken daily and a restore is tested quarterly
Availability is monitored and alerts are paged to on-call
New hires pass a background check before start
Employees complete security awareness training on hire and annually
Vendors handling client data are risk assessed before onboarding and annually
Confidential client files are deleted 90 days after contract end
